set.body:
Phase: core. Track: engine and tools.

Outcome
Four scripts drive the four journeys through the command line and the HTTP API on the packaged service with a real PostgreSQL. They need no person and none of the new screens. They run on every change, and they are how we come to believe the journeys will pass.

Acceptance
1. Bring in: synthetic DICOM is served by a stub XNAT; xnat2bids pulls, maps and converts it; the operator command imports it to a candidate; the candidate is accepted; the release has the expected files and coverage, and contains no XNAT label or accession identifier.
2. See: a search by words from the description finds the study and nothing the caller may not see; the catalog record, the coverage by participant and data type, and a variable query return independently written expected answers for the multi-modal fixture (SEE7).
3. Share: a steward grants a fixed release with discovery to a second person; that person's shares list shows it; they download the archive and its checksums verify; a later release stays invisible to them; the steward's grant list explains the access; after revocation the next read and a download in progress are refused.
4. Open: readiness fails for a stated reason, a correction fixes it and readiness passes; the package builds and the official validator passes; a publication record is proposed and accepted; the Neurobagel record is generated, loaded into the private node and found by a cohort query.
5. Each script checks every response against the published HTTP contract for the routes it calls. Routes missing from docs/http-api.openapi.json are added, and the known mismatch on the release read (the provenance field) is fixed. This is the journey-sized part of INT01.
6. The scripts run as hosted CI jobs beside console-backend and demo-instance. A failure names the journey and the step.
7. The scripts grow as the build items land. Each build item's evidence is its step here.

Not in scope
Browser automation of the new screens; their own console checks cover them. Reconciling all fifty routes with the contract (INT01, parked).

Start from
- scripts/check-console-backend.sh and scripts/check-demo-instance.sh: a packaged service, a disposable PostgreSQL, real requests.
- scripts/demo-instance.py: seeding through the public routes.
- docs/http-api.openapi.json.

Evidence
Five consecutive green runs on main, linked in a note here.
set.title: CORE1: Journey scripts: each journey runs end to end with no person
